product.title: Osaka Backstreet Night Tour

description.text: In Osaka, this evening backstreet walk covers Namba, Shinsaibashi, Dotonbori, and Amerikamura with published food stops after dark. The route stays on central south-Osaka streets rather than a Shinsekai stall crawl. The format suits visitors who want a guided night window without assembling separate dinner reservations. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Osaka, and the itinerary stays on Namba, Shinsaibashi, Dotonbori, and Amerikamura that define this outing rather than an Osaka Castle morning.

start.description: Meet at the published Namba meeting point confirmed at booking.

end.description: Return to your Osaka meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
